## 65782055e5a5

**Finding: canonical-ambiguous “2×2 bounding box” shortcut is not scheduled on the normal path.**

A plausible rival is: “For every blue component whose bounding box is `2×2`, fill the box red,” omitting the intended requirement that the component have exactly three cells. I enumerated all color-1 4-connected components in the five canonical inputs. Every canonical component with a `2×2` bounding box has size three, so this rival reproduces every canonical output.

Concrete counterexample:

```text
input       intended     shortcut
1100        1100         2200
1100        1100         2200
0000        0000         0000
0000        0000         0000
```

The intended rule leaves the full blue `2×2` square unchanged because its component size is four. The shortcut recolors it red.

The ordinary generator path creates only exact three-cell L components, so default lessons do not refute this rival. A `full_squares` degenerate override exists, but it is not part of a replayable default teaching schedule; moreover the weak baseline `self_check` accepts any grid containing blue. A future revision should schedule a full-square negative example and declare the size-agnostic rival/witness contract rather than relying on a special texture.
